page.title: Capture
page.description: Eros MemoryOS personal workspace. Capture a thought, inspect its source and keep tentative plans distinct from commitments.

architecture.contract: This screen answers: What should I capture or review next? Its finding is: Your website thought still has a suggested link.
architecture.grid: At 1440px, centre a 1152px canvas with 144px outer margins. Twelve 85px columns plus eleven 12px gutters equal 1152px. Spans: 9+3 = 861+12+279; 8+4 = 764+12+376; 6+6 = 570+12+570. Header, panels and final rows share canvas edges. Tablet uses available width minus 32px, with 12px gutters; phone uses one column with 16px margins.
architecture.signatureRule: Apply the existing achromatic ledger brand unchanged. Chrome and actions stay ink; the active source-position marker alone uses the data hue. The source thread connects an excerpt to its date, suggested links and interpretation. Keep coloured pixels below 1%, no resting shadows and no decorative charts.
architecture.rhythm: Sparse: 44px standard rows, 64px two-line memory rows, 24px panel padding, 12px horizontal and vertical gaps, 36px visual controls and at least 44px mobile hit areas. Use the brand type scale and weights. No extra KPI strip.

navigationDesign.layout: 48px top bar on the page ground, aligned to the canvas. Open-loop M mark, Eros MemoryOS and Personal identify the workspace. Search opens Memories. Menu opens hidden navigation; no persistent sidebar.
behavior: Root defaults to #/capture; direct links and browser back work.
The 256px desktop drawer overlays rather than resizing the canvas.
Opening the drawer transfers focus; Escape closes it and restores focus.
Custom tabs create real #/tabs/:id destinations with saved predicates.
Each active view has one h1 and one quiet Sample data notice.

transformation.compact: Full-screen menu sheet; mark, search and menu remain in the top bar.
transformation.medium: Hidden navigation remains a drawer; content uses 16px margins.
transformation.expanded: Top bar shares the 1152px canvas; drawer appears only on request.

sections.purpose: Capture comparative preferences without changing the fixed brand.
sections.userQuestion: Which way of working feels most natural?
sections.layout: #/preferences. Three 4-column pattern summaries, 376px each, use identical c01 content and brand tokens. An expandable full-width preview demonstrates capture-first, conversation-first or library-first interaction. Ranking has unique ordered positions and keyboard controls. These are concept patterns; no absent external reference is claimed.

motion.behavior: Pattern selection and ranking update stable cards with the common transition.

transformation.compact: Stack summaries; preview opens as a separate pane.
transformation.medium: Stack rather than create narrow comparison cards.

responsive: Use compact at 640px and below, medium at 641–1100px, expanded above 1100px. Verify 390px, iPhone 15 Pro Max width, 768px, 1100px and 1440px.

At 1440x900, each route shows every block assigned to that route with its heading and first row. The home shows composer, source thread, recent thoughts and upcoming reminders within the viewport. Separate routes are not squeezed onto home.

Home preserves the dealt workspace structure through a title and changing aligned spans. The brand's capture priority removes generic count tiles, tinted panels and conflicting example-screen spacing.
On phones, actionable reminder summaries move before long lists. List routes show their first row within the top 60% of the viewport.
No page-wide horizontal scrolling. Tabs may scroll within their own strip. Long source text wraps; source language uses automatic text direction.
RTL mirrors layout and logical drawer edge. Isolate dates, IDs and mixed-language fragments. Keyboard order follows reading order.
interactions: All actions use local in-memory state only. Text save creates a new thought and updates lists. Reload restores the deterministic sample dataset; no production persistence or backend is implied.

Recording is explicitly a Sample recording interaction with start, stop, cancel and review states. It requests no microphone access and creates no fabricated transcription. A newly saved sample take records measured interaction duration and has transcript unavailable.
Attachment opens a sample-source chooser for a chat, audio transcript or document excerpt. Selection adds a local sample source; no private file upload or parsing is implied.
Memory search performs real text filtering over source content and names. Ask uses a bounded fixture lookup with linked evidence; unsupported questions return Not enough information.
Links use one shared relationship store. Correction updates source, person, project and saved-tab views; Undo reverses the latest correction without replacing original text.
Reminder completion and date edits update all summaries. Calendar preview has no external write control. Rule preview and language preferences use explicit Save actions.

Every collection supports empty, real-zero, loading and error fixtures. Empty keeps its frame; zeros render as 0 with their noun; missing values use a small hyphen. Loading keeps labels and flat placeholder geometry. Errors stay within the failed block with Retry and never claim remote freshness.
Static shell and headings remain available during data errors. Unknown detail IDs show the route title, Thought not found or the relevant noun, and a working return action.

All rows and controls have neutral hover, a distinct selected fill with semantic selected state, visible keyboard focus and readable disabled states with reasons. Save is disabled for blank text, unchanged forms or invalid values.
Use one shared 180ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1) transition. Rapid repeated input interrupts previous transitions. Reduced motion renders final states immediately.
Dialogs trap focus, support Escape and return focus to their trigger. Route navigation focuses the h1; returning from a source restores the originating list selection and scroll.
A non-product test fixture mechanism exposes empty, loading, error and zero states for verification without adding diagnostic controls to visible product copy.
acceptanceCriteria: Inventory: the owner uses short capture and recall sessions on an iPhone. Most frequent job is recording or writing a thought. Other jobs are review, retrieve, correct, link, choose reminders and rank interaction patterns. Product-specific objects are source segments, tentative plans, people, projects and owner-selected reminders.

Sample dataset has six initial captures, two people, two projects, three reminders, one rule, one saved tab and six disconnected service entries. All are explicitly fictional and share one deterministic reference date of 7 Nov 2026 in Asia/Baghdad.

Capture fields: id, title, kind, sourceText, language, createdAt with timezone, ordered segments, optional durationSeconds, personIds, projectIds and interpretation status. Duration is seconds; displayed dates and times derive from the same timestamp.

Initial captures: c01 Website proposal, text, 7 Nov 09:10, p01/j01; c02 Birthday note, text, 6 Nov 18:30, p01; c03 Reading list, text, 6 Nov 12:15, p02/j02; c04 Page ideas, audio transcript sample, 5 Nov 20:00, 42 seconds, j01; c05 Book notes, document excerpt, 5 Nov 11:00, j02; c06 Evening thought, text, 4 Nov 21:00, no links. All dates are 2026 and timezone +03:00.

Source content: c01 contains the three quoted birthday, website and tentative-proposal sentences. c02 says Ali's birthday is 12 May. c03 says Sara suggested keeping a short reading list. c04 says A short introduction and a contact page might be enough. c05 says Keep a note of why each book matters. c06 says I want to leave room for unplanned ideas. No additional source facts are invented during answers.

People: p01 Ali, birthday month/day 05-12; p02 Sara, birthday missing. Projects: j01 Website proposal, tentative; j02 Reading list, active. Ali links to two captures, Sara to one; each project links to two; one capture is entirely unlinked.

Reminders: r01 Ask Ali about proposal scope, 9 Nov 2026 10:00, source c01; r02 Review reading list, 10 Nov 2026 18:00, source c03; r03 Ali's birthday, 12 May 2027 09:00, source c02. All begin open and none is overdue at the reference date. Their chosen status does not turn the underlying proposal into a commitment.

Rule rule01 previews an Ali birthday reminder at 09:00 without creating a duplicate r03. Saved tab t01 Website ideas filters projectId j01 and initially matches c01 and c04. Pattern rankings start unranked and become a unique ordering of three patterns.

Computed assertions: captures.length equals 6; text count 4 plus audio count 1 plus document count 1 equals 6; unique linked captures equal 5; unlinked captures equal 1; open reminders 3 plus done reminders 0 equals 3; saved-tab count equals its filtered rows; source segment indexes remain within segment length. After mutations, derive every count again rather than preserving seed totals.
Build creates the dataset and assertions later. This phase creates no files, sources no assets and changes no dependencies.

Each numeric block contains Sample data in blueprint copy. Build deduplicates it to one quiet Sample data notice per view. This is required content provenance, not a removable prototype disclaimer. No claims of live sync, AI processing, actual transcription or external account connection appear.

No supplied reference images exist. Use the dealt patterns and recorded brand as the composition authority; omit referenceDirectionId. Preference previews are internally defined concepts, not falsely attributed reference studies.
No imagery is needed, so all assetNeeds and componentNeeds remain empty. Draw the specified simple monogram and outline symbols natively; do not invent an existing logo file.

Verify loaded Geist families and weights after fonts are ready, tabular digit behavior, Arabic glyph fallback, mixed-language wrapping, text contrast, colour budget, exact grid arithmetic and one h1 per route.

Verify every destination and visible action, search and sorting, corrections with undo, reminder completion, rule preview, custom-tab creation, preference ranking, language changes, drawer focus, browser back, rapid input and reduced motion. Exercise each block's empty, zero, loading and error fixture. Record actual results later; this blueprint claims no tests passed.
